import re

def parse_links(body):
    """Extract [[wikilink]] titles from body text.

    Returns a list of title strings found inside double brackets.
    """
    return re.findall(r'\[\[([^\]]+)\]\]', body)

def resolve_links(titles, notes):
    """Map wikilink titles to note ids case-insensitively.

    Args:
        titles: list of link title strings from parse_links()
        notes: dict mapping note_id -> note object (with .title attribute)

    Returns:
        dict mapping each original title string to its resolved note id,
        or None if no matching note was found.
    """
    # Build case-insensitive lookup: lowercased title -> note id
    title_to_id = {}
    for nid, note in notes.items():
        t = getattr(note, 'title', str(note)).lower()
        title_to_id[t] = nid

    return {title: title_to_id.get(title.lower()) for title in titles}

from __future__ import annotations

import math
import re
import string
import unicodedata
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from typing import Iterable

from .models import Note

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Stopwords (common English words that carry little search value)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

_STOPWORDS: set[str] = {
    "a", "an", "and", "are", "as", "at", "be", "but", "by",
    "for", "from", "has", "have", "he", "her", "his", "how",
    "i", "if", "in", "into", "is", "it", "its", "just",
    "me", "my", "no", "not", "of", "on", "or", "our",
    "so", "than", "that", "the", "their", "them", "then",
    "there", "these", "they", "this", "to", "too", "up",
    "was", "we", "were", "what", "when", "where", "which",
    "while", "who", "whom", "why", "will", "with", "would",
    "you", "your",
}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Tokenizer
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _tokenize(text: str) -> list[str]:
    """Lowercase, strip punctuation, split on whitespace, drop stopwords."""
    text = text.lower()
    # Remove ASCII punctuation (keep apostrophes inside words)
    text = re.sub(f"[{re.escape(string.punctuation)}]", " ", text)
    # Remove Unicode punctuation characters (e.g., …, ‑, etc.)
    text = "".join(
        " " if unicodedata.category(ch).startswith("P") else ch
        for ch in text
    )
    tokens = text.split()
    return [t for t in tokens if t and t not in _STOPWORDS]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# IDF computation (global corpus statistics)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _compute_idf(notes: list[Note]) -> dict[str, float]:
    """Compute inverse document frequency for every term across *notes*."""
    n_docs = len(notes) or 1
    doc_freq: Counter[str] = Counter()

    for note in notes:
        tokens = set(_tokenize(note.search_text()))
        doc_freq.update(tokens)

    idf: dict[str, float] = {}
    for term, df in doc_freq.items():
        idf[term] = math.log((n_docs + 1) / (1 + df))  # non-negative IDF

    return idf


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# TF-IDF scoring
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _tfidf_score(note: Note, query_terms: list[str], idf: dict[str, float]) -> float:
    """Return a scalar relevance score for *note* against *query_terms*."""
    tokens = _tokenize(note.search_text())

    # Term frequency (simple count, no length normalisation for simplicity)
    tf = Counter(tokens)

    score = 0.0
    for term in query_terms:
        if term in tf:
            score += tf[term] * idf.get(term, 0.0)
    return score


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Public API
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def search(
    notes: list[Note],
    *,
    query: str = "",
    tags: list[str] | None = None,
) -> list[Note]:
    """Return notes matching *query* (full-text TF-IDF) and/or *tags*.

    Parameters
    ----------
    notes: list of Note objects to search.
    query: free-text string; tokenised and scored via TF-IDF (case-insensitive).
    tags: list of tag strings, or None to skip tag filtering.

    Returns
    -------
    Filtered subset of *notes*, ranked by relevance (descending).
    """
    results = list(notes)  # copy to avoid mutating caller

    if tags:
        tag_set = {t.lower() for t in tags}
        results = [n for n in results if tag_set & {t.lower() for t in n.tags}]

    if query:
        idf = _compute_idf(results)  # compute on filtered set for consistency
        query_terms = [t for t in _tokenize(query) if t]  # skip empty tokens
        if not query_terms:
            return []  # query reduced to stopwords only → no matches

        scored = []
        for n in results:
            tokens = _tokenize(n.search_text())
            if all(t in tokens for t in query_terms):  # AND semantics: all terms must be present
                scored.append((n, _tfidf_score(n, query_terms, idf)))
        # Sort descending by score; ties broken by id for determinism
        scored.sort(key=lambda pair: (-pair[1], pair[0].id))
        results = [n for n, _ in scored]

    return results
